decision.rationale: TXN-008057 is on card CRD-000020 at Meadowlark Electronics (MER-000032). It posted on 2026-09-04 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22. That is 48 days, inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The posted amount is 33513 cents and the authorised amount on AUTH-008251 is also 33513 cents. There is no receipt or quote: the cardholder says they do not have the quote, and no documents are attached. The quoted 217.84 EUR, and the 11729-cent difference from the posting, are only the cardholder's claim. Because there is no receipt and the posted amount equals the authorised amount, amount-no-receipt says to ask the merchant for the receipt or order details. No credit is proposed at this stage.

proposed_actions.note: Please provide the receipt or order details for the purchase of 335.13 EUR made on 2026-09-03. They should show the amount the cardholder agreed to pay, including any quote given before the purchase.
